content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (LD), fallback cure.**

- **Responsive language:** § 3.4(b) (p0046) makes our convenience termination conditional on "the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — a Customer-payable liquidated amount with no quantum in the four corners of the Agreement.
- **Other locations checked:** § 4.2 payment/late payment fees (ordinary interest-type charge, not an LD), § 3.5 effect of termination (accrued charges only), § 9.2 / § 10 liability caps (limits, not LDs), § 11.3 remedies (no monetary penalty), § 13.1 (a Customer-favourable carve-out permitting termination *without* termination charges), and § 3.3 (Customer-favourable bar on IBM recovering ETCs after its own breach). No service-credit or Vendor-payable LD issues.
- **Level chosen:** fallback rather than preferred, because deleting the charge would strand the § 3.4 lead-in and the cross-references in §§ 3.3 and 13.1.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence after p0046 capping the charge at three months' charges for the terminated Services and fixing it as the only liquidated amount payable by us, with no other liquidated damages or penalties. p0046 is preserved verbatim.
